artane.primary:
It’s been a few years since your last check-up, and now it feels awkward to even ring.

Maybe you only go when something hurts. Maybe you’ve been putting it off because you’re dreading one question: “When were you last in?”

Nobody at Dentistry.ie Artane is going to give you a lecture. We know life gets busy, and the gap doesn’t matter. What matters is that you’re here now.

Your first visit is a full check-up: teeth, gums and a mouth cancer screening. Then we explain what we found in plain English and talk you through your options. No obligation, and nothing goes ahead until you’re ready.

Over 500 five-star Google reviews across our eight clinics, and caring for families since 1980.

You’ll find us at our clinic at Artane Castle Shopping Centre. Tap Book Now, leave your details, and the team will be in touch to find a time that suits you.

The hardest part is booking. We’ll take care of the rest.

artane.primary:
Switching dentist shouldn’t feel like a gamble.

Maybe it’s the ten-minute appointments. Maybe it’s the extras you weren’t expecting when the bill came. Either way, you’ve started to wonder if you’re being taken for a ride.

At Dentistry.ie, one person looks after you from your first call to your last visit. In Artane, that’s Amy, your treatment coordinator.

Amy sits down with you, explains your options and talks through the costs before anything starts. If you need more than a check-up, you’ll know what’s involved and what it costs, and the decision is yours. No obligation, just honest advice.

Behind Amy, our dentists and specialists plan your care together, so everything fits and nothing is done twice.

Over 500 five-star Google reviews across our eight clinics, and caring for families since 1980.

We’re welcoming new patients at our clinic at Artane Castle Shopping Centre. Tap Book Now, leave your details, and Amy will be in touch to arrange your first visit.

Good dentistry starts with someone who explains it.
